name: Suno

name: Google Lyria / MusicFX
knownFor: Google’s music-generation models (Lyria) and MusicFX / Flow Music features, sold through Google AI plans.
popCaption: Editorial estimate, with distribution through Google AI plans (not a music-specific traffic figure) · checked Nov 2026
learn: Music inside a Google AI plan

Official one.google.com/about/google-ai-plans (checked Nov 2026) lists music access (Lyria / Flow Music) on Google AI Plus at $4.99/month and higher plans with more credits. Rated on Plus, the cheapest individual paid plan that advertises music generation.
